parts.text: Add send later to the composer. The user must be able to cancel it, and it must never go out early.
People write replies at night and do not want them to arrive at night.
The user can pick a time in the composer.

To: dana@example.com
Subject: Monday plan

[Send later ▾]  [[Send]]
  Tomorrow 8:00
  Monday 9:00
  Pick a time
Send later saves the message with a time. It does not send.
The server sets the owner and the status. The client cannot.
A user can hold 50 scheduled messages at most.
How many scheduled messages per user?
Guess: one user can fill the worker's queue.

parts.name: limit

parts.text: The user sees and changes scheduled messages in one list.
A new folder lists them, soonest first.
Three actions work on a message until it starts to send: Edit, Send now, Cancel.
A message is sent only at its time. A failed send is kept.
An edit close to the send time can lose to the worker's claim.
A worker claims due messages once a minute.
Cancel wins if it lands before the worker's claim.
A failed send is tried again, then left for the user.
Should a failed send retry on its own?
The user presses Try again.

parts.name: retry

parts.text: Two workers could claim one message, unless the claim is atomic.
The user is told when a scheduled message fails.
The message shows Not sent, with a line such as: We tried 3 times. It is in Scheduled.
How is the user told?
